visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor street setting near a playground with colorful structures. A host with short black hair and glasses wearing a blue button-down shirt holds a microphone and speaks to a female guest. The guest has reddish-brown hair in a long braid and wears a light blue polo shirt. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) Sudden jump cut to a skit-like scenario. The guest appears in a domestic/office setting with a white desk and computer monitor. She looks distressed, holding her face near a bottle of CeraVe cleanser. A male character with short black hair briefly appears in a separate frame. (3) Return to the outdoor street interview. The host and guest continue their conversation with animated gestures. Graphic overlays with the CeraVe logo and product descriptions appear near the guest's face. The camera uses a handheld follow-shot style. (4) Scene transitions to a bright studio background with blue and white geometric shapes. A woman identified as a doctor, wearing a white lab coat over a blue top, holds a CeraVe product and speaks directly to the camera with a professional posture. (5) Fast-paced montage showing the guest washing her face with white foam, smiling brightly. Close-ups of the product packaging (CeraVe Blemish Control Cleanser) are shown against a clean white background. (6) Final group scene in the studio. The doctor, the guest, and the male character stand together. The guest points toward the screen as a lineup of CeraVe products and the "油痘剋星 煥膚營" slogan appear in the foreground.
